system.description: You were raised around shops, caravans, counting houses, warehouses, or family ventures in which every possession had a cost and every relationship had practical value.

legacy.name: Family Ledger
legacy.text: At the beginning of each Adventure, gain 1 Temporary Influence. Temporary Influence granted by this Legacy that remains when the Adventure ends is lost.

familiarity.name: Commercial Networks
familiarity.text: You recognize guild marks, shipping labels, trade conventions, common commercial deceptions, and signs of shortage or surplus. In a settlement with an established market, you can identify the brokers, wholesalers, guild representatives, and other people through whom serious business is conducted.
